title: Day of the Year
description: Given a string date as YYYY-MM-DD, return the day number of the year.
pseudocode:
1. split date string into Y, M, D
2. create array of days per month
3. check if year is leap
4. sum days of previous months + D

steps.note: Parsing date: 2019-01-10 into year 2019, month 1, day 10
Defining days in each month for a non-leap year
Checking leap year: 2019 % 4 != 0, not a leap year
Calculating total: month 1 has 0 full months before it, so 0 + 10 = 10
